_readme: Failure-alert settings for the SFN module (auto_stage_calib.py, stage_init.py), read by alerts.py.
Set enabled=true once smtp_host/from_addr/to_addrs below are filled in.
The SMTP password is NOT stored here -- set it in the environment variable named by
smtp_password_env (default MSEM_ALERT_SMTP_PASSWORD) before launching the SFN app,
e.g. via Windows System Properties > Environment Variables.
For a text-message alert, add a carrier email-to-SMS gateway address to to_addrs, e.g.:
If your institution's SMTP relay allows unauthenticated internal senders, leave
smtp_username blank and the code will skip the login() step.
